form_intro.heading: Tell us about your project.
form_intro.text: Fully licensed, WorkSafeBC insured, and Red Seal certified — we're ready to review your project details and get back to you promptly.

insurance.heading: Insurance & Licensing
insurance.text: Renova Design Build carries full WorkSafeBC coverage and liability insurance across commercial, residential, and remote industrial project types. Red Seal certification and utility-level site safety compliance available on request.

service_area.heading: Metro Vancouver & Regional British Columbia.
service_area.text: We're based in Metro Vancouver and regularly take on structural, remediation, and turnkey construction work throughout Regional BC — including remote community projects.
